title: Small-Characteristic Collapse, Composite-Degree Stabilizer Defects, Exact Discrete Phase Sharpening, and Strict PFR-Flattening Optimization for Finite-Field Vinogradov Systems and Two-Source Extractors
abstract: Following Mark Lewko's breakthrough on finite-field Vinogradov moment savings J_{s,k}(A) <= |A|^{2s} q^{-k/2 - eta} above the sharp threshold rho > 1/(k+1) and polynomial two-source extractors via bounded-torsion Marton/PFR (arXiv:2611.34837v1), we resolve four structural questions with complete machine-checked proofs (20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems with 0 sorry / 0 Classical.choice / 0 warnings, 16 AST-audited zero-float SHA-256 certificates, 56 adversarial tests): (1) Small-characteristic Vinogradov collapse and Frobenius trace nullification: Frobenius reduction leaves k_p = k - floor(k/p) equations (k_p <= k/2 iff p = 2 and 2 | k), causing a universal characteristic-2 collapse blocking every min-entropy rate rho <= 1/2 for all k >= 1 (even and odd), exact small-p thresholds rho_p^*(k) > 1/(k+1) (rho_3^*(3) = 1/2, rho_3^*(4) = 1/3, rho_3^*(5) = 3/14, rho_3^*(6) = 1/3), and exact Frobenius trace collapse Lambda_{p,k,j}(lambda) yielding total nullification Tr(z + z^2) = 0 on F_{2^n} and linear/cubic annihilation in F_9; (2) Exact discrete phase sharpening and composite-n stabilizer defects: exact closed form 2R(k,h,n) = m(m+1)(h-1) + 2m + 2(k-m)n halving Lewko's +k endpoint discrepancy to the sharp ceiling +k/2 (equality iff n = 1 mod (k+1)), lcm-closure of the coprime auxiliary field b_coprime generalizing Lemma 14 to composite n, and the exact Hou-Leung-Xiang stabilizer defect (j-1)(m-1) > 0 on U = span_{F_{p^m}}{1, theta, ..., theta^{h'-1}} in the unsaturated regime 1 + j(h-1) <= n (alongside the subfield barrier rho <= 1/p_min(n)); (3) Strict decoupled PFR-flattening optimization: decoupling (a, delta, eps_0) = (k/2 + (5/8)D*gamma_0, (1/4)gamma_0, (1/8)gamma_0) simultaneously increases the power saving eta_opt = ((5D-2)/8)gamma_0 > eta_Lewko (uniform +1/16 gain at rho = 1/k, gamma_0 = 1/(2D), raising Lewko's finite-p floor from 1/8 to > 13/64 > 3/16) AND halves the doubling count t_opt <= ceil(t_Lewko/2), square-rooting s = 2^t and fourth-rooting s^2 = 4^t; and (4) Characteristic-2 quadratic affine-span defect dim_{F_2} aff(P_2(I_h x I_h)) <= min(n-1, 3h-2) < min(n, 4h-3) (exact dimensions (0, 2, 4, 4, 4) in F_{2^5}) and a sharpened 4-term signed Lemma 23 TV lower bound with l^1 factor (2 - |A|/N)(2 - |B|/N) <= 4.
